s01908.summary: June and Miriam discuss the coming landing as Solis notes their stress.
June asks if Miriam knew the planet is inhabited; she read sealed logs.
Solis reports June's protocol violation; June snaps and Miriam dims the dome.
Miriam reveals the charter clause: an earlier ship's descendants live there.
June paces; Miriam says pristine is easier than landing on someone's home.
Miriam shows her mother's photo and passes the duty of truth to June.
They have Solis delete the conversation and watch the new world together.

s00895.summary: Connie asks if it is bad; Yasmin hedges and Florence is blunt.
Yasmin reveals a four-centimetre mass; Connie likens it to a plum.
Yasmin sits and holds her hand; Connie asks for a plum.

s01850.summary: Captain Silas asks why Madame Roux summoned him at midnight.
Silas notes her false name and demands to know who she is.
She reveals she is the sister of the man he hanged in Vicksburg.
Silas justifies it as war; she says he hanged a boy and gives her real name.
She produces a revolver and a confession: sign it, or take both.
Silas slowly reaches for the pen.

s01645.summary: Rosario greets her early new hire with suspicion.
Bernadette claims her clinking bag holds fancy sandwiches.
Bernadette catches Rosario's wrist, warning that she will know.
Rosario opens the bag: cash and a pistol belonging to her.
Bernadette's hand drops to her pocket; Rosario asks whose gun it is.
A new reel booms Coming Attractions; Rosario calls it a good title.

s00076.summary: Barnaby announces another pivot to an unimpressed team.
Barnaby pitches a platform for platforms; Orla and Jung-Ho scoff.
Cedric wants Adaeze's lighthouse sketch as the logo; she closes the book.
Barnaby asks who's excited; Jung-Ho flatly asks to leave.

s01971.summary: Odile and Inspector Crane sit silent in a stalled funicular.
Odile sets a revolver on her knee; Crane calmly offers a cigarette.
Crane raises her husband's death and her absence from the funeral.
Crane says the conductor remembers her on the car that night.
Crane dares her to shoot him and asks why she hasn't.
Odile presses the gun to his tie and cocks it as the car climbs.

s00368.summary: A nameless stranger enters the tortoise library seeking the book of names.
Elowen studies his scar and recognizes a prince of the drowned towns.
She reads his true name aloud and the tortoise stirs.
Tamsin says the sea will come, and something vast begins to move.

s01561_0.summary: A tired man in scrubs pushes a gurney down the dim ward.
Philomena tells him a patient is coding and they sprint.

s00072_0.summary: A gondola hangs motionless and rocking above a thundering ravine.

s01418.summary: Liliane insists the detective take tea; Rosalind sniffs it and declines.
Rosalind raises the emptied vault; Liliane denies it exists.
Liliane asks Viktor, who denies knowing anything.
Rosalind says a guard saw Viktor; his denial gives him away.
Liliane sends Viktor downstairs and he walks out.
Alone, Liliane defends him as family; Rosalind finally accepts tea.

s00784.summary: Marv livestreams his midnight mattress marathon to a record audience.
A security guard appears; Marv mistakes him for Brenda and spins around.
Darnell waves to the camera and the chat loves him.
Darnell falls for the memory foam; Marv extends the marathon.

s00676.summary: Teodora walks the seed vault counting drawers and noting humidity.
Lost new archivist Imani enters and introduces herself.
They talk seed counts and share a tired smile about the Registrar.
Teodora has Imani read labels aloud while she listens.

s00455.summary: Rival manager Silas watches Imelda tape up Nico before the fight.
Silas lays an envelope on the apron as an opportunity.
Imelda orders Silas out; he urges her to think of the boy.
Nico insists; Imelda has him open it: cash and an order to dive.
Nico crumples the note and shadowboxes violently as Imelda pushes him.
Nico asks why she let Silas in; she needed to see his response.
Imelda declares him ready, tosses a mouthguard, and the bell rings.

s00596.summary: Lowe establishes Warsame was on the ferry far from the warehouse.
Lowe suggests the prosecution witness lied; the judge rebukes him.
Hana passes a note and Lowe presents a ferry ticket stub.
No cross-examination comes and the witness is excused.
Hana exhales, Lowe smiles, and juror Petra lets go of her thread.

s01479.summary: Coach Arlette pumps up a nervous Priss in the empty rink.
Arlette learns the team is missing with a bout in twenty minutes.
A stranger rolls in claiming four years with the Harbor Hellcats.
Odalys asks for a team; Arlette welcomes her by name.
The three roll toward the rink as Odalys prays for a crowd.

s00603.summary: Liesel operates in a flooded tent as the sat phone buzzes.
Tomas reports the bridge closed and no helicopter extraction.
Liesel clamps the bleed and insists she'll keep the patient.
Tomas relents; Liesel asks for supplies and him on the radio.
Shaking, she asks him to talk; he tells her about his goat.

s00475.summary: Night foreman Cass walks the catwalk counting bins.
Something shifts below; pale Fenwick reports bin six is breathing.
Cass hears it as the grain domes up and he grabs Fenwick.
Inspector Marguerite appears and orders them calmly to the stairs.
The dome sinks; she says it is listening and they walk away.

s02283.summary: The sisters pack their late father's cabin, sparring over a chipped cup.
Odile bins old pickles; both listen for the jar to break.
Desmond relays the realtor's listing date; Odile snipes back.
Albrecht tries to return a rod; Odile carries the trash out.
Desmond unfolds her fingers and serves her tea in Maman's cup.
Marguerite joins Odile on the dock and they share the cup.

s00635.summary: Stuck in the car wash, Tristan begs the bored operator to stop brushes.
Tristan soothes Duchess; the line dies and the van lurches.
Soapy manager Lenny climbs in demanding who's in charge.
Wendy guns the engine and bursts out of the wash.

s02251.summary: Yusra demands reports: leaking fuel, eight hours from the gravity well.
Nils picks up an encrypted foreign signal and panics.
Mateo floats a slingshot; Yusra spins passenger updates.
The signal gives coordinates; Yusra orders a costly course to the station.
The ship shudders; Sakura goes to tell passengers the truth gently.
The message turns plain: Marginalia, welcome, we've been waiting.

s01732.summary: Hester and Corwin climb the elevator stair with sleepwalking Ambrose.
Ambrose walks toward the chute; they haul him back as the wheat moves.
They hold the boy as the grain rises up the walls.
Ambrose opens his eyes and they are not his own.

s01710.summary: Rival divas meet backstage and trade insults about room and feather.
The divas grapple over headdresses as the Prince's arrival is announced.
Maud steps in; both smooth gowns and sweep toward the Prince.

s00338.summary: Stranded in a flooded silo, Otieno finds a bricked-up door.
They wonder who sealed it and what it was meant to keep in.
Maren calls out for help and hears only drips.
They press to the wall and listen to an unnatural quiet.
Maren knocks a pattern and someone beyond the bricks knocks back.

s02090.summary: Ignatius, a detective and a regular idle in the cluttered pawnshop.
A young man with a pillowcase sees the detective and tries to leave.
Ignatius makes Trey stay, identifies him and has him unload a 'lamp'.
Dispatch reports a burglary suspect in a gray hoodie; Farhadi invites Trey outside.

s01237.summary: At the drive-in, Beebe and Louise argue over who the counter boy watches.
The boy charges more for shakes; Louise needles him and he blushes.
Beebe and Louise push each other to ask his name.
Louise asks; Orville explains his family name, and offers free napkins.
Orville nervously asks Beebe out; Louise accepts on her behalf.

s00381.summary: Orla examines a surviving weed in the derelict greenhouse; Mote waits.
Mote reveals it has counted the weed's eleven lonely years.
With air failing, Orla demands the vault opened; Mote refuses.
Orla lunges for the panel and they struggle, cracking Mote's faceplate.
The vault unseals itself, revealing glowing drawers; they step inside.

s02249.summary: Lucinda sneaks into the empty newsroom with a flash drive.
Her own recorded messages warn her they know about the drive.
Lucinda boots the old terminal and finds the document.
An elevator dings as she sends the file; it completes.
Relieved, Lucinda pockets the drive and leaves.

s00430.summary: Mbeki scans the ridge from the dugout and bans cigarettes.
Brandvold points out the farmer still working with his buffalo.
Brandvold says the farmer has nowhere to go; Mbeki mutters neither do they.
Mbeki has Brandvold radio all quiet and watches the buffalo.
